opportunities.title: IT Client Acquisition Partner Needed
opportunities.description: Business Development & Client Acquisition Partner for Aevona Solution Project Overview Aevona Solution is a technology solutions company looking for a motivated business development partner who can help us acquire clients for our IT and technology services within both Indian and international markets. Our team handles website development, custom web applications, mobile applications, website redesigns, AI/ML solutions, automation, cloud services, and other technical solutions. We are looking for someone who can focus on finding potential clients, initiating conversations, and bringing genuine business opportunities to our company. This person should also assist in building our market presence as the demand grows. Long-term growth opportunities, better positions, and pay increments will be offered as the company scales up. Responsibilities: - Identify businesses in IT markets that need websites, web applications, mobile apps, or other IT solutions. - Research potential clients in Indian and international sectors. - Generate and qualify genuine business leads. - Conduct personalized cold outreach through email and applicable channels. - Communicate with prospects to arrange project discussions. - Follow up with interested prospects to convert leads into paying clients with successful contracts. Compensation: - Competitive 20% commission on successfully acquired projects. - Commission calculated on actual payments received from clients without upfront payments. - Payment terms documented via Freelancer.com milestones. Ideal Candidate: - Experience in B2B client acquisition within the IT sector is a priority. - Skilled in communication and strategizing market penetration campaigns. - A background in finding or marketing services of IT companies or web development agencies would stand out strongly. If you excel in generating demand across India and internationally while fostering partnerships efficiently across technology domains Aevona Solution looks forward to partnering exactly skilled bidders/talent like yours!

opportunities.title: Full-Stack Developer (Next.js / React / Node.js) – SaaS Platform Development
opportunities.description: Project: Blacksheet – Course Creation & Business Management Platform We are building Blacksheet, an all-in-one platform for course creators, coaches, and digital entrepreneurs. The platform aims to simplify how creators build, manage, and sell their digital products, courses, memberships, and online businesses. We are looking for an experienced Full-Stack Developer ( individual, no company ) or teams to first audit our existing codebase, then work on specific development tasks, and eventually help us build a complete website and sales funnel system with a visual page builder similar to ClickFunnels and GoHighLevel. This is an ongoing development opportunity for someone who can understand an existing SaaS architecture and contribute to building a scalable product. Phase 1: Existing Codebase Audit The first assignment will be to conduct a comprehensive audit of our existing Blacksheet platform. Responsibilities: * Review the existing frontend and backend architecture. * Analyze code quality, structure, and maintainability. * Identify bugs, security vulnerabilities, and performance issues. * Review API integrations and database architecture. * Identify incomplete features and potential architectural problems. * Evaluate the platform’s production readiness. * Provide a detailed audit report with prioritized recommendations. We want someone who can understand the existing system rather than immediately rewriting things. Phase 2: Course Template Development After the initial audit, the next assignment will involve developing a course template using Next.js and integrating it with our existing backend. Responsibilities: * Develop a dynamic course template using Next.js. * Connect the template with existing backend APIs. * Dynamically render course content, modules, lessons, and other relevant data. * Integrate the existing custom domain connection functionality. * Generate a working preview URL through a connected domain. * Ensure the template communicates correctly with the existing platform. * Implement responsive layouts and ensure a good user experience. Important: The custom domain connection functionality is already implemented. You will be working with the existing functionality rather than building it from scratch. Phase 3: Website System & Visual Page Builder Once the initial assignments are completed successfully, we plan to work together on building a complete website and funnel-building system for Blacksheet. The goal is to develop a flexible website-building experience comparable to ClickFunnels and GoHighLevel. The system will include: 1. Website Management System * Create and manage multiple websites. * Website settings and configurations. * System pages and reusable layouts. * Custom domain and publishing integration. 2. Landing Page & Funnel System * Create landing pages. * Build sales funnels with multiple steps. * Manage funnel navigation and page relationships. * Create sales, checkout, thank-you, and other funnel pages. * Connect pages with existing products, offers, and backend functionality. 3. Visual Drag-and-Drop Page Builder * Visual page editing experience. * Drag-and-drop elements and sections. * Reusable sections and components. * Responsive editing for desktop, tablet, and mobile. * Styling and layout controls. * Save, preview, and publish functionality. * Integration with the existing backend and website rendering system. The objective is to build a flexible system that allows users to create complete websites, landing pages, and sales funnels without writing code. Required Technical Skills * Strong experience with Next.js and React. * Solid JavaScript and TypeScript knowledge. * Experience with Node.js and REST API integration. * Experience working with PostgreSQL and Prisma ORM. * Understanding of SaaS application architecture. * Experience with dynamic rendering and reusable frontend components. * Understanding of authentication, permissions, and multi-tenant systems. * Good understanding of responsive frontend development. Preferred Experience Experience with any of the following would be a major advantage: * Building visual drag-and-drop page builders. * Developing website builders or landing page builders. * ClickFunnels or GoHighLevel architecture. * Dynamic website rendering systems. * Custom domain and subdomain integrations. * Funnel-building platforms. * Multi-tenant SaaS applications. How We Plan to Work We prefer a phased engagement rather than handing over the entire project at once. 1. Start with a paid code audit. 2. Move to a fixed-price course template development assignment. 3. Based on performance, continue with hourly development work on the website system and page builder. 4. Potentially establish a long-term development relationship. We are building an MVP, so the focus is on practical implementation, clean architecture, and prioritizing essential functionality over unnecessary complexity. We don’t expect everything to be enterprise-grade from day one, but the code should be structured so the platform can grow without requiring major rewrites. To Apply Please include the following in your proposal: 1. Your experience with Next.js, React, Node.js, and SaaS development. 2. Examples of website builders, page builders, or similar platforms you have developed. 3. Have you previously built a drag-and-drop visual page builder? If yes, please share examples. 4. How would you approach auditing an existing SaaS codebase before making changes? 5. Your hourly rate and availability. Please share actual projects or working examples wherever possible. We are looking for someone who can take ownership of development tasks, understand the bigger product architecture, communicate clearly, and grow with the platform over the long term.

opportunities.title: AI Lead Generation Automation Expert
opportunities.description: Project Title: AI Automation & Multi-Channel Lead Gen Expert for Premium US-Focused Consulting Firm Project Description: I am the principal of Lajara Group LLC (a subsidiary of Lewis International Ltd.), a bespoke corporate consulting firm. We build companies, governance structures, and wealth strategies for founders, family offices, and high-net-worth clients across the US, Philippines, Bahamas, Belize, Cook Islands, and Saint Kitts & Nevis. We operate on a strict "NO TEMPLATES. EVER." policy. Every client receives services drafted from scratch. We are seeking a proven, results-driven AI Automation Specialist to build and manage our marketing and lead generation engine, targeting primarily US-based clients while allowing for global scalability. The Goal: To design and implement a fully automated, AI-driven lead generation and client communication system. The system must handle prospecting, nurture leads, and autonomously respond to client inquiries across Email, WhatsApp, and Facebook Messenger, ultimately converting them into booked consultations. Scope of Work: 1. AI-Powered Multi-Channel Communication & Appointment Booking (Critical) Multi-Channel AI Chat: Implement an AI system (leveraging our existing stack: Claude, ChatGPT, and DeepSeek) to autonomously respond to client inquiries in real-time via Email, WhatsApp, and Facebook Messenger. AI Appointment Setter: Integrate the chat system with our calendar to automatically qualify leads and book appointments for our $300 USD paid consultation. Human Handoff: The AI must know when to escalate to a human (Nolan Lewis) for complex or high-value inquiries. Contextual Knowledge: Train the AI on our service catalog (Corporate Formation, Trusts, Wealth Strategy, CRM/ERP Setup, etc.) and our "No Templates" philosophy so responses are accurate and professional. 2. AI Lead Generation Engine (US Market Focus) Build a targeted B2B lead generation system (using tools like Apollo, Clay, Instantly, or similar) to identify US-based founders, family offices, and SMEs expanding internationally. Automate personalized outreach sequences highlighting our cross-border expertise (US/Philippines/Bahamas/Belize). CRM integration (we use Odoo; experience is a plus) to manage leads and track conversions. 3. Social Media & Content Automation Create a content calendar for LinkedIn (Primary) and Twitter/X (Secondary). Use AI to repurpose our high-level service descriptions into engaging thought leadership posts for US investors. Establish a voice reflecting our pillars: Leadership, Innovation, Integrity, Excellence. 4. Marketing Automation & Funnels Set up email marketing funnels for our $300 consultation offer. Automate nurture sequences for prospects who download a lead magnet or visit our landing page. Target Audience: US-based Founders & Start-ups; Family Offices & High-Net-Worth Families; SMEs expanding or restructuring; Investor Groups & Funds. Requirements (Must-Have): PROVEN TRACK RECORD: You must provide case studies or verifiable examples of AI automation systems you have built for high-ticket B2B services (Consulting, Legal, Finance, or Real Estate). Do not apply if you cannot demonstrate prior success in a similar industry. Multi-Channel Expertise: Demonstrated experience integrating AI chatbots across Email, WhatsApp, and Messenger with appointment booking capabilities. AI Stack Proficiency: Experience working with Claude, ChatGPT, DeepSeek, and automation platforms (Make.com, Zapier, or similar). US Market Knowledge: Understanding of how US businesses evaluate offshore structures (Philippines/Bahamas/Belize). Professionalism: Flawless communication and branding consistency, as we serve high-net-worth individuals. To Apply: Please provide: Case Studies: Examples of AI lead gen or multi-channel chat systems you have built (with metrics if possible). Technical Plan: A brief outline of how you would integrate Claude/ChatGPT/DeepSeek across WhatsApp, Email, and Messenger to book appointments. Pricing & Timeline: Estimated timeline and pricing for Phase 1 (Setup) vs. Phase 2 (Monthly Retainer/Management). About Us: Lajara Group LLC is the corporate consulting arm of Lewis International Ltd., a global holding and investment company. We work across the US, Philippines, Bahamas, Belize, Cook Islands, and Saint Kitts & Nevis. One Vision. Many Businesses. One Legacy. Recommended Tags for Freelancer Post: AI Automation Lead Generation B2B Marketing WhatsApp API Chatbot Development LinkedIn Marketing Odoo CRM Appointment Setting Claude AI ChatGPTCore Technical Skills (Non-Negotiable) 1. Multi-Channel AI Chatbot Development WhatsApp Business API: Experience with Meta's official API, Twilio, or 360dialog for automated messaging. Facebook Messenger API: Integration and automation via Meta Business Suite. Email AI Automation: Inbox management and auto-response systems (e.g., Gmail API, Outlook, or platforms like Front/Intercom). Conversational AI Design: Prompt engineering and context management for Claude, ChatGPT, and DeepSeek (must know how to switch between models based on task complexity and cost). 2. AI Appointment Booking & Calendar Integration Calendar APIs: Google Calendar, Calendly, Cal.com, or Microsoft Outlook integration. Lead Qualification Logic: Ability to build AI flows that screen prospects (budget, jurisdiction, service type) before booking the $300 consultation. Payment Gateway Integration: Linking booking to Zelle confirmation or alternative payment processors (since you use Zelle, they need to understand manual verification workflows or Stripe/PayPal for automated booking). 3. Automation & Orchestration Workflow Automation: Make.com (formerly Integromat), Zapier, or n8n (advanced). CRM Integration: Odoo (critical since you use it), HubSpot, or Salesforce. API Management: REST APIs, webhooks, and JSON handling for connecting disparate tools. 4. Lead Generation & Outreach B2B Prospecting Tools: Apollo.io, Clay, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Instantly, Lemlist, or Smartlead. Email Deliverability: Domain warm-up, SPF/DKIM/DMARC setup, and inbox rotation. Data Enrichment: Clearbit, ZoomInfo, or similar for qualifying US-based leads. 5. Social Media Automation LinkedIn Automation: Experience with tools like Dripify, Expandi, or Phantombuster (within LinkedIn's terms of service). Content Repurposing AI: Using AI to turn your PDF service catalog into LinkedIn posts, tweets, and email snippets. Scheduling Tools: Buffer, Hootsuite, or Metricool. Strategic & Domain Skills (High-Value Differentiators) 6. B2B High-Ticket Sales Funnel Knowledge Understanding of long sales cycles for consulting/legal/finance services. Experience building nurture sequences that educate prospects before the paid consultation. Ability to design lead magnets (e.g., "Free Guide: 5 Jurisdictions to Protect Your Wealth") that feed into the AI chat system. 7. US Market & Cross-Border Awareness Familiarity with US business entities (LLC, C-Corp, S-Corp) and why founders seek offshore structures. Understanding of jurisdictions like Delaware, Wyoming, Bahamas, Belize, and the Philippines (basic level—they don't need to be lawyers, but they must understand the terminology to train the AI correctly). 8. Prompt Engineering & AI Model Management Ability to write system prompts that enforce your "NO TEMPLATES. EVER." brand voice. Experience with RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)—feeding your service catalog into the AI so it answers accurately without hallucinating. Model routing: knowing when to use DeepSeek (cost-efficient) vs. Claude (nuanced writing) vs. ChatGPT (general tasks). 9. Analytics & Reporting Setting up dashboards (Google Looker Studio, Odoo dashboards) to track: Leads generated per channel Chat-to-booking conversion rate Appointment show-up rate Cost per lead Soft Skills & Professional Requirements 10. Proven Track Record (Verifiable) Case studies required—not just "I can do this" but "Here is a system I built for a consulting firm that generated X leads and Y bookings." References from previous clients in high-ticket B2B sectors. 11. Communication & Project Management Fluent English (written and spoken) for client-facing AI training and your own collaboration. Experience with project management tools (ClickUp, Asana, Trello) to manage the build. Ability to document the system (SOPs) so your team can maintain it. 12. Security & Compliance Awareness Understanding of data privacy (GDPR for global clients, Philippine Data Privacy Act RA 10173 since you operate there). Experience securing API keys and client data in automation workflows. Red Flags to Screen For (Do NOT Hire If...) They only know one AI model (e.g., only ChatGPT) and cannot explain when to use Claude or DeepSeek. They have no experience with WhatsApp Business API (this is critical and non-trivial to set up). They cannot show a live demo of an AI chatbot they have built. They propose using "templates" for your outreach (violates your brand). They are unfamiliar with Odoo or refuse to learn it. Suggested Freelancer Skill Tags (Copy-Paste) text AI Automation, Chatbot Development, WhatsApp API, Facebook Messenger API, Make.com, Zapier, n8n, Odoo, Apollo.io, Clay, LinkedIn Automation, Prompt Engineering, Claude AI, ChatGPT, DeepSeek, Google Calendar API, B2B Lead Generation, Email Marketing, CRM Integration, Appointment Setting

opportunities.title: n8n Telegram Internal Q&A Bot
opportunities.description: I need a small, self-hosted Telegram chatbot built with n8n that can answer employees’ questions about our internal documents, policies, and procedures. All answers will come from a curated list of question-and-answer pairs that I will supply in CSV or JSON; the bot does not need to crawl websites or parse files. Key points to address • Data source: the static Q&A list I provide • Access control: replies must be limited to a whitelist of approved employee Telegram usernames or IDs; anyone else should receive a polite refusal message • Workflow: an n8n workflow should listen to messages, match the incoming text to the closest question in the list (exact or fuzzy), and return the stored answer. If no match is found, it should send a fallback response that I can edit later • Deployment: everything will run on my existing n8n instance (Docker). Please include clear setup instructions and any environment variables I’ll need to add • Handover: export of the finished workflow, a short README, and a brief screen-share walkthrough so I can maintain it myself Success is a bot that responds accurately and instantly inside Telegram, respects the access restrictions, and can be updated easily when I add new Q&As.

opportunities.title: Property PA for Maintenance Tasks
opportunities.description: I need a sharp, organised personal assistant who can step straight into the flow of my small property portfolio and keep paperwork, tenant messages, and maintenance coordination under control. Your first priority will be handling property paperwork and all incoming messages. Most contacts will be tenants reporting maintenance issues or suppliers, contractors, and other service providers arranging access or quotes. When a tenant reports a problem, I want you to go ahead and contact our pre-approved contractors, book the repair, and then confirm back to me once everything is scheduled. Typical day-to-day activities will include: • Monitoring the dedicated property inbox and phone line • Logging every enquiry in our simple spreadsheet / PMS • Drafting and filing tenancy documents, inspection reports, and compliance certificates • Liaising with plumbers, electricians, cleaners, and similar trades to secure dates, costs, and follow-up paperwork • Keeping tenants updated on job progress and confirming completion photos or invoices are returned I work largely in Google Workspace, Excel, and WhatsApp, so comfort with those tools (or quick learning) is essential. Strong written English, a calm phone manner, and the ability to chase contractors without needing reminders will make you perfect for this role. If you can start quickly and keep everything running smoothly in the background, let’s talk.

opportunities.title: Cloud Monitoring & Alerting Setup
opportunities.description: I want to tighten the way we operate in the cloud by adding reliable, real-time monitoring and alerting to our deployment pipeline. The priority is clear: I am not asking for a full rebuild of the CI/CD flow; instead, I need the observability layer that tells us when something breaks, why it broke, and how urgently we must act. In other words, the job is to set up or improve our cloud deployment and automation with a special focus on monitoring applications and getting alerts when problems happen. Our stack already follows modern DevOps practices (containerised services, infra-as-code, and automated deployments), but the feedback loop is too quiet. I am open to the toolset that makes the most sense—whether you prefer Prometheus + Grafana, ELK-based solutions, Datadog, New Relic, or native offerings such as AWS CloudWatch. What matters is that we can see CPU, memory, latency, error rates, and custom business metrics, then receive actionable alerts through Slack, email, or PagerDuty before users feel the pain. Deliverables I expect: • A production-ready monitoring and alerting stack integrated with our existing cloud environment. • Dashboards that are understandable at a glance, grouped by service and environment. • Alert rules tuned to sensible thresholds, with notification channels wired up and tested. • A short hand-off document or walkthrough video so my team can extend and maintain the setup confidently. If you have a track record of building cloud-native observability solutions and can move quickly without breaking what already works, let’s talk details.

opportunities.description: I need someone to add a simple AI chatbot to my existing WordPress site using a ready-made plugin. I’m looking for a no-code setup, not custom development. I’ll provide a short FAQ, a link to the full FAQ page, and a welcome message. The setup should include: • Installing and configuring a suitable plugin. • Adding the FAQ and welcome message. • Showing the chat widget across the site and matching its colors. • Setting up a message directing visitors to the FAQ page when the bot can’t answer, if the plugin supports it. • Checking that the widget works on desktop and mobile. Any plugin or API fees should be listed separately and approved before installation. Please suggest a plugin and your estimated turnaround. If any requirement needs custom coding, let me know before starting.

opportunities.title: Complete Plastic Recycling Line Design
opportunities.description: The system must accept mixed or recycled plastic waste, feed it through size-reduction, Washer, drying, and a robust extruder, then finish with downstream equipment able to deliver consistent plastic sheets or profiles. Because the feedstock is variable, the screw geometry, filtration stages, and temperature zones need careful thermal and structural analysis, and the hydraulic press or calibrator station has to maintain tight dimensional tolerances. I’m looking for a mechanical designer who is comfortable taking ownership of every machine in the line—shredder, conveyors, extruder, screen changer, cooling bath, haul-off, cutter or press—and integrating them into a single layout with realistic maintenance envelopes and safety guarding. Finite-element checks on high-load parts such as the screw, barrel, gearbox mounts, and press frame are essential; CFD or extrusion-specific simulation to predict melt flow and residence time would be a plus. Deliverables I will need: • 3D CAD assemblies and fully detailed part drawings (SolidWorks, Inventor, or similar) • FEA reports for critical components and welded frames • A single-line layout with utilities, footprint, and operator flow • Bill of materials with specified off-the-shelf components • Exploded views and simple assembly instructions for the shop floor If you’ve already designed extrusion or hydraulic press equipment and can show calculations or test results, that will weigh heavily in your favor. Let me know which CAD and analysis packages you prefer, your estimated timeline, and anything you need from me to start.

I have rough sketches and key room sizes ready to share as soon as we start. If you regularly create residential layouts in AutoCAD and enjoy squeezing the most function out of a limited footprint, I’d love to see how you can bring this floor plan to life.

opportunities.title: Manufacturable Prototype CAD Redesign
opportunities.description: I already have a working prototype, but it still needs that last push to become truly production-ready. The goal is straightforward: turn my current design into a dfm, industrial model that manufacturers can pick up without extra re-engineering. Here’s the situation: • Stage: A prototype that needs improvement for manufacturing. • Key focus: Choosing the right material and production method so the final part is easy to source, cost-effective, and durable. What I need from you is an updated 3D CAD package (SolidWorks, Fusion 360, or similar) that resolves any manufacturability issues, plus clear recommendations on materials and the most suitable production techniques—be that 3D printing for short runs, CNC machining, laser cutting, or full mold making for mass production if it proves optimal. Deliverables - Optimised 3D model files in native and neutral formats (STEP/IGES). - Brief DFM report outlining design changes, material selection logic, and recommended manufacturing process. - Basic 2D drawings with critical dimensions and tolerances for supplier reference. Acceptance criteria: the updated model must pass standard DFM checks, reflect the agreed material choice, and be ready to quote with at least two manufacturing vendors. If you’re experienced in design-for-manufacture, materials engineering, and industrial CAD, I’d love to see how you can streamline this prototype into a production-worthy part.

opportunities.title: Interactive Full-Stack Portfolio Demo Platform
opportunities.description: I want to ship an all-in-one web app that visitors can explore as a living proof of how I unite full-stack engineering with brand design. The site should feel like a real workspace, but its core purpose is to act as a portfolio demo—polished enough for public viewing, sandbox-safe for anyone to click around, and structured so recruiters or prospects immediately understand my range. Core experience • Landing view gives a quick tour of the four pillars—Developer, API, Data, Design—then invites people to dive deeper. • The deepest, most hands-on section must be the Data Dashboard and Brand Design Studio. I need live KPI charts that refresh from an automated ETL pipeline, plus a design playground where users can swap color palettes, banners, and design tokens and watch the entire UI update instantly. Supporting modules • Developer Kanban board: In Dev / Review / Deployed swim-lanes that accept drag-and-drop cards and pop up the underlying tech specs. • API webhook sandbox: Live REST testers for Stripe, HubSpot, and WhatsApp endpoints with real-time JSON logs. Safe keys and dummy payloads only. • ETL pipeline: Scheduled job that ingests messy CSV, SQL, and CRM records, cleans them, and feeds the dashboard without manual refresh. Tech expectations Modern front-end (React, Next.js, or similar), real-time interactions via WebSockets where it makes sense, and a clean component library so the design studio can hot-swap themes. Server side can run Node, Python, or Go—whichever lets you wire Stripe, HubSpot, and WhatsApp webhooks quickly. Charts should come from D3, Chart.js, or Recharts so I retain flexibility. Deliverables 1. Source code in a private Git repo with clear README. 2. Deployed demo link (Vercel, Netlify, or Render). 3. Seed data and scripts for the ETL. 4. Quick video walkthrough showing the dashboard and design studio in action. I’ll handle copy and final branding—just give me a framework that makes the tech and the visuals shine together.

opportunities.title: 3D Nursery Rhyme Animation
opportunities.description: I’m producing a new YouTube series of nursery-rhyme videos and already have the songs recorded. What I now need is the full 3D side: modelling, rigging, and animating bright, Cocomelon-style human child characters that will sing and move to each track. For every rhyme (roughly 2-3 minutes) you will: • Design and rig appealing toddler characters with oversized, friendly features • Build simple, colourful sets and props that suit each song’s theme • Animate the children so their lip-sync, facial expressions, and body language perfectly match my supplied audio • Render the final animation in 4K (or supply project files plus high-quality playblast if we decide on in-house compositing) I handle music, lyrics, and final editing, so your focus stays purely on the 3D character work and scene animation. If you already work in tools such as Maya, Blender, Cinema 4D, or Unreal Sequencer and have a showreel that proves smooth kid-friendly motion, please share it. Consistent style, vibrant colour palettes, and clean, loop-ready movements are key acceptance criteria—think “instantly recognisable by a preschooler” quality. This first video will serve as a pilot, but I plan an entire season of rhymes, so a good collaboration here can turn into steady, long-term work.

opportunities.title: STOL Aircraft Structural Design Package
opportunities.description: Title: Aircraft structural engineer: welded 4130 STOL frame, full design package (paid trial first) Budget: AUD $4,000–10,000 total, paid by milestone Description: I’m building one two-seat STOL taildragger (600 kg MTOW, amateur-built, Australia, 19-series approval). It has a welded 4130 tube fuselage, a strut-braced wing, a 7075 aluminum spring gear bar and fabric covering. The layout is modelled in CAD and I have a first-pass beam analysis, a weights and CG ledger, a fittings schedule and a control system sheet. I need an experienced aircraft structural engineer to take it from layout to build-ready design. This is a staged job, paid per milestone. You can be paid for stage 1 and stop there, and so can I. Stages Paid trial (AUD $100–250, fixed): design and check the lift-strut lower lug at the fuselage hoop. Deliver a one-page hand calculation (double shear, bearing, bypass, bolt bending, lug tear-out, tube and weld check, margins of safety), a simple fabrication drawing, and a short note on any assumptions or load problems you find. Structural review and tube sizing: frame, wing, gear and tail. Fixed price quoted after stage 1. Fittings and control systems: wing root and strut fittings, gear saddle, engine mount, hinges, stick, pedals, cables, pushrods, pulleys, trim and flaps. Fixed price quoted after stage 2. Fabrication drawings and approval documents: weld jig drawings, parts and hardware list, and stress documentation for RA-Aus 19-series approval. Fixed price quoted after stage 3. The full job is intended for the stage 1 winner, subject to the quality of their work. I can end the contract after any stage. All drawings, calculations and source files are mine. You must include in your bid (bids without these will not be considered): The name or type of an aircraft you have analysed or designed. Whether you have worked on welded 4130 tube structures. 2–3 sentences: how do you account for weld heat-affected zones and joint efficiency when sizing a 4130 cluster joint? Who signs your calculations, with their qualification, and what standard you work to (FAA, EASA, RA-Aus, other). A redacted page from a stress report or a drawing from past aircraft work. I’ll supply: a one-page trial brief with loads and geometry. After the trial, the CAD/STEP model, the beam screening report and the design brief. Not wanted: generic bids, 3D modelling or rendering only, and anyone who can’t take responsibility for their structural calculations.

opportunities.title: Urban Multi-Family Floor Plan Design
opportunities.description: I’m developing an urban multi-family residential project and need clear, buildable floor plans that show exactly how the building will sit on the site and how each unit will relate to shared open areas. The intent is to strike the right balance between the number of homes and generous communal space, specifically a landscaped courtyard or garden at ground level and a usable rooftop terrace. Here’s what I need: • A site-responsive concept layout illustrating building footprint, access, parking (if required), and how residents move between indoor and outdoor zones. • Scaled floor plans for each level that organise the units efficiently while keeping natural light and ventilation in mind. • Integration of the courtyard/garden and rooftop terrace so they feel like extensions of everyday living rather than leftover space. • Digital files (DWG or RVT preferred) plus PDFs ready for review; layered so future adjustments are straightforward. • A brief design narrative explaining the key decisions, unit counts, and how the scheme meets zoning or setback limits. Plans can be produced in AutoCAD, Revit, ArchiCAD, or another professional drafting package—whatever you’re most comfortable with, as long as the output is clean and editable. I already have the site survey and municipal guidelines; once we begin, I’ll share those along with the preliminary massing studies that prompted this rethink. What I’m missing is a cohesive plan that makes the project flow, optimises unit size, and gives residents meaningful outdoor space. If you can turn those ideas into a clear, coordinated set of floor plans, let’s get started.

opportunities.title: Simple 3D Mascot Character
opportunities.description: I’m putting together a short animated video and need a single, low-poly 3D mascot to serve as the main on-screen “host.” The look I’m after is deliberately simple and stylized—clean geometry, minimal textures, and an inviting silhouette that will read well at small sizes. Here’s what will make the model usable for me: • A fully modeled character in a neutral pose, delivered in an industry-standard file such as FBX or OBJ • Basic, efficient UVs and flat, low-detail textures (no 8K maps or photoreal shaders) • A lightweight rig with clear naming so I can drop the asset straight into Blender or Maya for animation • Scale set to real-world units and origin at ground level for easy scene placement I have a rough storyboard and reference sketches to guide proportion, color palette, and personality, and I’ll share those as soon as we connect. If you’ve built similar mascot-style assets before, links or small clips of your work will help me see how you handle topology and rig controls. Once the mesh, rig, and a quick playblast test look good, the project is complete. Looking forward to collaborating and getting this mascot on screen.

opportunities.title: Urgent 3D Assembly Drawings
opportunities.description: I have an invention that needs to be translated into clear, professional 3D design drawings right away. The focus is on showing every individual part and exactly how those parts come together, laid out on A0 sheets created in Autodesk Inventor. Timing is critical—work must begin as soon as you accept the project and continue for the next 12 hours so we can hit an overnight deadline. What I expect from you • Separate Inventor part files for each component • A fully constricted Inventor assembly (.iam) illustrating fit and motion if applicable • A0-sized drawing sheets that include exploded views, call-outs, and any essential dimensions or notes for fabrication • Final deliverables in both native Inventor format and PDF for quick sharing Acceptance criteria The drawings must open error-free in Inventor, every part must locate correctly inside the assembly, and the A0 sheets must print at scale without cropping. Meeting these points within the 12-hour window will mark the job complete. If you are ready to jump in immediately and maintain real-time communication while the work is underway, let’s start now.

opportunities.title: Full-Color 3D Character Model
opportunities.description: I have a 2D illustration of a character and I’d like it turned into a fully textured, print-ready 3D figure. The drawing should guide the design but you’re free to reinterpret details and add your own style, as long as the character’s core look and colour palette stay recognisable. You’ll handle everything from sculpting through to UVs, textures and final optimisation so I can send the file straight to a colour 3D printer. Please deliver both the editable scene file and a watertight export in a format that supports colour (OBJ/MTL with textures, VRML or 3MF). Acceptance criteria • Clear visual link to the provided artwork, with creative yet faithful styling • Manifold geometry that passes a slicer check without fixes • Accurate, seamless colour mapping across the whole model I’ll share the illustration and pose notes once we start and I’m happy to answer questions during the process. Show me examples of stylised or collectible-type characters you’ve produced so I can get a feel for your approach.
opportunities.contractor_info: Demandante verificado en Freelancer.co (Anuncio #40828295, publicado hace 15 horas (hoy)). Presupuesto ofrecido: USD 15 - 25.

What I expect from you • Generate furniture and interior elevations, sections and any remaining detailed views directly from the model. • Add clear dimensions, material and finish call-outs so a contractor can pick the sheets up and build from them. • Arrange the views, title blocks, scales and notes so each sheet looks professional and print-ready. Project constraints & timing The submission to my client is due Monday, 23 November, which means the job has to be wrapped up within the next 2–3 days. Please confirm you can start right away and deliver on that schedule. To help you start swiftly I will supply: • The current SketchUp (.skp) file • Reference images and mood shots for materials and furniture choices What I need in your reply 1. A link or PDF showing previous work created specifically in SketchUp LayOut (not just screenshots of 3D models). 2. Your availability over the next 72 hours. 3. Your best fixed price, bearing in mind my limited budget. If you have deep familiarity with Layout viewports, tags/layers, and automatic dimensioning, this should be a smooth assignment. Looking forward to seeing how quickly and neatly you can turn my model into clear, construction-ready sheets.

opportunities.title: Desarrollo e Implementación de Embudo de Ventas y Posventa con Capa...
opportunities.description: Buscamos un profesional experto para diseñar, construir e implementar un embudo de ventas y posventa integral para nuestros servicios de estética. El proyecto incluye la creación de una landing page de alta conversión, flujos automatizados de comunicación por correo electrónico y SMS, y una fase de capacitación intensiva para nuestro equipo de marketing. El trabajo se centrará en la optimización del recorrido del cliente desde el clic en el anuncio hasta la confirmación de la compra y el seguimiento posventa. La landing page se desarrollará utilizando inteligencia artificial (integración de Claude) con Elementor en WordPress, incorporando botones de pago y de WhatsApp, formularios de contacto y pop-ups para maximizar la conversión. Se configurarán flujos automáticos de correo electrónico y SMS para diversas etapas, como el seguimiento de carritos abandonados, la confirmación de pagos con instrucciones para agendar sesiones, y comunicaciones de promociones y posventa. Es fundamental que estos flujos aseguren que cada contacto sea registrado, el pago reconocido y los mensajes entregados en el momento oportuno. Un componente clave del proyecto es la capacitación de un miembro de nuestro equipo de marketing. El profesional deberá trabajar de forma remota, en sesiones en vivo con pantalla compartida, explicando sus decisiones, resolviendo dudas y acompañando al equipo mientras practica la configuración. El objetivo es que nuestro equipo adquiera la autonomía necesaria para replicar y lanzar futuras promociones de forma independiente. El embudo debe entregarse funcionando en nuestras cuentas, con plantillas editables y una guía breve para futuras implementaciones. Categoría: Programación y Tecnología Subcategoría: Programación Web ¿Cuál es el alcance del proyecto?: Crear un nuevo sitio personalizado

opportunities.title: Teleoperador B2B para Restaurante Ibiza
opportunities.description: Titolo Teleoperador/a freelance B2B para restaurante en Ibiza – Campaña local Descrizione da pubblicare Somos Carpe Diem, un restaurante y pizzería con servicio de delivery en Ibiza. Buscamos un/a teleoperador/a freelance con experiencia en llamadas comerciales B2B y residencia en España. opportunities.title: Quick AutoCAD Plumbing Revisions
opportunities.description: I’m supplying a clear, digital-quality PDF of a plumbing layout. I need you to bring that PDF into AutoCAD, trace it into a clean DWG, and then carry out the small set of edits I will mark for you in advance: a few pipe runs must be moved or redrawn, and some accompanying labels/dimensions updated so everything reads correctly. Because I only have the PDF, you will be starting from that file, but its resolution is crisp enough for accurate tracing and scaling. When the revisions are complete, please return: • an editable DWG that keeps sensible layers and original scale, and • an updated PDF ready for issue. This is a focused task, so let me know your fixed price and the earliest you can deliver the finished files.

opportunities.title: Clothing Design & Production Setup
opportunities.description: I’m laying the groundwork for my own clothing label and need an experienced partner to turn my early ideas into production-ready reality. The first collection is broad—think graphic T-shirts and hoodies, versatile activewear, relaxed casual pieces, and a few standout dresses—so versatility in style is important. Right now I have mood boards and inspiration images, but no finished artwork. I need you to translate those concepts into fully rendered designs and professional tech packs that a factory can follow without questions. Once the tech packs are ready, I’ll also rely on you to identify and approach suitable manufacturers, compare their capabilities (MOQ, pricing, quality control), and help manage the sample stage. Deliverables • Final design files for each garment in the collection • Comprehensive tech packs (measurements, construction, trims, fabric specs, colorways) • A short-list of vetted manufacturers with comparative notes and initial quotes • At least one physical or digital sample approval per style If you have a track record of taking brands from concept to first production run, please tell me about similar projects, the design tools you use (Adobe Illustrator, CLO 3D, etc.), and your network of manufacturers.

opportunities.title: Integrar Pagos Electrónicos en Lavadora
opportunities.description: Dispongo de una lavadora que hoy solo funciona con monedas físicas y quiero modernizarla para atraer más clientes. Necesito añadir dos métodos de cobro adicionales: • Pago con móvil mediante QR • Pago con tarjeta débito o crédito Al confirmarse el pago el equipo debe habilitarse, pero el usuario elegirá el ciclo deseado en el panel habitual antes de que comience a girar. Busco una solución completa que incluya: 1. Selección e instalación del lector o terminal compatible (QR y tarjetas). 2. Diseño del circuito de control que “desbloquee” la lavadora tras el pago, manteniendo intacto el monedero mecánico existente. 3. Firmware o software necesario para gestionar transacciones y enviar la señal de habilitación. 4. Integración con la pasarela de pago correspondiente y pruebas de cobro en vivo. 5. Manual de instalación, diagrama de cableado y guía de usuario final para que pueda replicarlo en otras unidades. Valoro que la electrónica quede protegida contra humedad y vibraciones propias de lavanderías, y que el sistema pueda registrar un historial básico de ventas. Si has trabajado antes con controladoras de lavandería, terminales POS, Arduino, ESP32, Raspberry Pi o soluciones IoT similares, menciona tu experiencia. Espero un prototipo funcional listo para instalar, más soporte remoto durante las primeras puestas en marcha.

opportunities.description: **Project Title: Professional 3D Character / Outfit Creation for Roblox** Hi, I am looking for an experienced 3D artist who can create a high-quality, game-ready 3D character outfit for my Roblox project. **Requirements:** - Create a complete 3D character outfit/armor. - High-quality and detailed 3D modelling. - Proper textures, materials and UV mapping. - Optimized mesh suitable for Roblox. - Compatible with Roblox R15 avatar rig. - Properly fitted to the Roblox avatar body. - Clean topology and optimized polygon count. - Include all required accessories and wearable parts. **Deliverables:** 1. Original editable Blender (.blend) file. 2. FBX export file. 3. Texture files (PNG). 4. Roblox-compatible model. 5. Screenshots or preview renders. 6. Assistance with Roblox Studio importing and testing. **Important:** The model must be fully original and I must receive commercial usage rights and ownership of the final deliverables. Please share your previous Roblox 3D modelling work, estimated price and delivery time. Thank you.

opportunities.title: Blender Mapping – GSPro Golf Course
opportunities.description: I’ve already gathered everything you’ll need to build Riverside Country Club (18 holes, Bozeman MT) in Blender for a GSPro release—terrain mesh, high-resolution DEM data, and precise KML outlines for tees, greens, fairways, and bunkers. Your job is to drop those outlines onto the terrain, keep every elevation and scale intact, and hand the work back to me as an organised, fully editable .blend file. Accuracy requirements • The supplied KML outlines must be followed exactly—no smoothing or reshaping. • All additional course elements should be placed as accurately as possible, drawing on satellite imagery or public GIS layers when my source files don’t cover them. Please structure the scene so I can turn layers on and off quickly: • Core: terrain mesh (locked) • Tees, greens, fairways, bunkers (separate collections) • Cart paths, water hazards, out-of-bounds lines • Trees, buildings, bridges, and other on-course details Deliverable One clean .blend file with the above collections clearly named and positioned across all 18 holes. Timeline & budget I have a fixed budget of $180 total ($10 per hole) and would like to keep momentum on this, so include your estimated turnaround when you bid. When you respond, link or attach at least one example of similar Blender terrain, GIS, or golf-course work so I can see how you handle real-world data. Freelancers anywhere in the world are welcome—if the result lines up perfectly with the KML, that’s what counts.

opportunities.title: Development, Maintenance and Enhancement of Legal Care Website and Android Application
opportunities.description: I have an operational Legal Care platform—a PHP-based website paired with a Kotlin Android app—that delivers plain-language legal information and automated document drafting. The core is stable, yet several pain points remain: small UX flaws, sluggish API calls, and missing content modules that stop users from finding the exact template or statute they need. During the next four weeks I want to: refactor the existing codebase, introduce new document-generation workflows, polish the UI so it feels consistent across web and mobile, and harden security around user data. Continuous maintenance (bug fixes, Play Store updates, server patches) is part of the agreement, but the first milestone is a feature-complete, production-ready release by month’s end. Because the project centres on providing legal information and document services—not on lawyer matchmaking or appointment scheduling—your past experience building information portals, e-signature flows, or template generators will be most relevant. Please show me comparable apps or sites you have maintained or taken from MVP to polished product; a concise summary of frameworks, cloud stacks, and deployment pipelines you used is enough—I do not need a lengthy proposal. The repository sits on Git with a CI/CD pipeline to AWS Lightsail. Android Studio, Retrofit, Room, and PHP-MySQL on the backend are the current tools; if you prefer Laravel or an alternative ORM, just outline the migration path. Acceptance for the initial release: • All existing screens load without error on the latest two Android versions and on major desktop/mobile browsers. • New document templates render correctly, save to user accounts, and can be shared as PDF. • Average API response time ≤ 300 ms under typical load. • OWASP top-10 scan shows no high-severity issues. If this timeline and scope fit your skill set, send over a brief note highlighting your directly relevant experience and links to live work. I’ll jump on a quick call to align on priorities and grant repository access right away.

opportunities.title: Asesoría Marketing USA Servicios
opportunities.description: Quiero potenciar la presencia de mi empresa de servicios en Estados Unidos y, sobre todo, afinar cómo nos comunicamos con el público B2C. Mi prioridad es mejorar la comunicación y el posicionamiento de la marca para que nuestros mensajes resuenen de manera clara y convincente con consumidores estadounidenses. Lo que necesito de ti: • Revisar y pulir nuestros mensajes clave y la propuesta de valor, adaptándolos a la cultura y expectativas del mercado norteamericano. • Diseñar o actualizar presentaciones, propuestas comerciales y demás materiales de venta (pitch decks, folletos, one-pagers) que transmitan profesionalismo y coherencia de marca. • Optimizar la comunicación con nuestros canales de comercialización y socios, asegurando un discurso unificado en todos los puntos de contacto. Cómo me gustaría trabajar: comienza con una auditoría rápida de la comunicación actual, define una guía de tono y estilo específica para EE. UU. y, a partir de ahí, desarrolla las piezas y plantillas necesarias. Valoraré experiencia comprobable en marketing de servicios dentro del mercado estadounidense, dominio de inglés a nivel nativo o casi nativo y capacidad para entregar archivos editables listos para implementar. Si cuentas con casos de éxito o muestras relevantes, compártelos para evaluar tu enfoque.

opportunities.title: Edición Documental para YouTube
opportunities.description: Busco a alguien que transforme mis grabaciones largas en un video atractivo para mi canal de YouTube. Qué recibirás de mi parte – El video principal sin cortes. Qué espero de tu trabajo – Visionado y selección de los mejores momentos para construir la narrativa. – Búsqueda y añadido de imágenes de apoyo, clips de archivo y música libre de derechos que enriquezcan la historia. – Edición con ritmo fluido: transiciones limpias, corrección de color básica, ecualización de audio y mezcla con la banda sonora. – Inserción de títulos o rótulos solo cuando aporten claridad al relato. Entregables • Video final listo para subir (mín. 1080p, formato .mp4). • Archivo del proyecto editable para posibles ajustes futuros. Si ya tienes experiencia creando contenido documental para YouTube y sabes dónde encontrar buen material libre de derechos, me encantará ver ejemplos de tu trabajo.

opportunities.title: Meta Ads para Leads de Peluquerías
opportunities.description: Título Especialista en Meta Ads para generar leads de salones de peluquería (B2B) en toda España Descripción Somos una distribuidora de marcas premium de cosmética capilar en España y buscamos a una persona freelance especialista en Meta Ads (Facebook e Instagram) para generar leads de salones de peluquería de toda España (venta B2B). El seguimiento comercial de los leads lo hacemos nosotros. Queremos empezar cuanto antes. Qué harás: Crear y lanzar las campañas de generación de leads (estructura, audiencias y segmentación para toda España). Crear los anuncios: textos y creatividades, con varias versiones para testear. Configurar el formulario de captación (nombre del salón, ciudad, teléfono, correo y marcas que usa). Optimizar y escalar las campañas para conseguir el máximo de leads válidos al menor coste. Enviarnos un informe semanal sencillo (leads, coste por lead y qué anuncios funcionan). Qué es un lead válido: un salón de peluquería interesado en nuestras marcas que rellena el formulario con datos de contacto reales. Qué no incluye: llamar o gestionar los leads ni consultoría de crecimiento. La política de privacidad y el consentimiento del formulario los aportamos nosotros. Condiciones: Inversión publicitaria de prueba de hasta 10.000 €/mes, que pagamos directamente a Meta. Trabajo sobre nuestra cuenta publicitaria, con acceso como colaborador. Tarifa fija mensual durante un periodo de prueba de 3 meses, sin parte variable, con revisión al final del primer mes. Requisitos: Experiencia demostrable en campañas de generación de leads en Meta Ads con presupuestos comparables. Casos con resultados (leads y coste por lead), idealmente B2B o negocios locales. Español de nivel nativo o C1.

opportunities.title: Testers en Colombia · Desde tu celular · USD 50 por prueba completada
opportunities.description: Testers en Colombia · Desde tu celular · USD 50 por prueba completada Hola. En Puli AI ayudamos a que las apps financieras funcionen mejor para personas reales. Buscamos una persona en Colombia para probar apps de empresas financieras líderes (incluidas algunas que cotizan en bolsa), con su propia cuenta. En cada prueba se usa la app que asignemos. Qué vas a hacer Esto es más que opinar sobre una app: 1. Te registras una vez en cada app que te asignemos y completas su verificación de identidad con tus propios documentos. Esto pasa dentro de la app: Puli nunca ve tus documentos. 2. Haces el depósito mínimo que pide la app con tu propia tarjeta Visa o Mastercard, crédito o débito. Ese dinero vuelve a la misma tarjeta cuando lo retiras, y te reembolsamos todas las comisiones y costos por cambio de moneda. 3. Retiras ese dinero a la misma tarjeta. 4. Después de cada paso nos escribes por correo qué pasó, con pantallazos donde los datos privados estén tapados. Te enseñamos cómo. Tiempo: te decimos la duración estimada antes de cada prueba. La primera prueba en cada app toma más porque incluye el registro y la verificación. Es una misión de varias semanas, con al menos 2 pruebas por semana, en los horarios que te queden bien. Pago - USD 50 por cada prueba completada, en un plazo máximo de 7 días después de revisar tu prueba. El pago se hace en dólares (USD) a través de Freelancer.com. - Te reembolsamos todas las comisiones de tu tarjeta, las comisiones de la app y los costos por cambio de moneda, también a través de Freelancer.com y en el mismo plazo. El depósito vuelve a tu tarjeta según los tiempos de tu banco y de la app; normalmente unos días hábiles. - Si la prueba falla por un problema de la app, lo revisamos contigo caso por caso. - Trabajas como contratista independiente (prestación de servicios independiente), con un acuerdo de tester que firmas antes de tu primera prueba; tú te encargas de tus propios impuestos. No prometemos un ingreso fijo. Requisitos - Vivir en Colombia y tener un documento de identidad colombiano vigente - Tener 18 años o más - Tarjeta Visa o Mastercard (crédito o débito) de un banco colombiano, a tu nombre - Cualquier celular (iOS o Android) - Hablar español. Algo de inglés es un plus, pero no es obligatorio Tu privacidad Puli nunca te pide ni ve números de tarjeta, números de cuenta, saldos, contraseñas, códigos de verificación ni documentos de identidad. Para inscribirte solo necesitas tu nombre, correo, ciudad y tipo de celular. Puedes pedir que borremos tus datos cuando quieras: escríbenos por el chat de Freelancer.com y lo hacemos en un plazo de 48 horas. Para aplicar, envía tu propuesta aquí en Freelancer.com y cuéntanos tu ciudad y tu tipo de celular.

opportunities.title: Animación 3D de Personaje
opportunities.description: Quiero crear un personaje 3D en estilo caricatura que protagonice un breve vídeo para redes sociales. El personaje debe contar una pequeña historia: moverse con naturalidad, gesticular de forma expresiva y, si es posible, sincronizar labios con mi locución (te entregaré el audio definitivo). Lo que necesito de ti: • Diseño o adaptación del modelado (cartoon). • Rig completo con controles faciales y corporales listos para animar. • Animación final de aproximadamente 30-45 s que narre la historia de forma clara y entretenida. • Iluminación y render en formato cuadrado 1080×1080 (MP4), además de los archivos fuente del proyecto (Blender, Maya o herramienta similar). Aprecio sugerencias sobre guion, timing y acting para que el resultado sea dinámico y capte la atención desde los primeros segundos. Entregaré referencias visuales y la pista de audio tan pronto iniciemos. Si tienes ejemplos previos de personajes cartoon animados para Instagram, TikTok o YouTube Shorts, compártelos para ver tu estilo. Estoy listo para comenzar en cuanto definamos la duración exacta y el flujo de trabajo.

opportunities.title: CREACIÓN DE 2 VIDEOS EDITABLES PARA PRIMERA COMUNIÓN (NIÑO Y NIÑA)
opportunities.description: Estamos buscando un diseñador gráfico y audiovisual con experiencia en creación de invitaciones digitales animadas y videos para eventos religiosos. Somos una imprenta y empresa de diseños personalizados. Necesitamos desarrollar dos videos de Primera Comunión: uno para niño y otro para niña. **OBJETIVO PRINCIPAL** Crear dos videos elegantes, modernos y profesionales que funcionen como plantillas maestras editables. Estos videos serán utilizados comercialmente para ofrecerlos a nuestros clientes, por lo que necesitamos poder personalizarlos posteriormente sin depender del diseñador. ### 1. VIDEO PARA NIÑO - Temática: Primera Comunión. - Estilo elegante, moderno, delicado y religioso. - Colores: celeste, blanco, perla y dorado. - Elementos: cáliz, cruz, Biblia, paloma del Espíritu Santo, ángeles y detalles decorativos. - Animaciones profesionales y transiciones suaves. ### 2. VIDEO PARA NIÑA - Temática: Primera Comunión. - Estilo elegante, delicado, femenino y religioso. - Colores: rosado pastel, blanco, perla y dorado. - Elementos: flores, cáliz, cruz, Biblia, paloma del Espíritu Santo y detalles decorativos. - Animaciones delicadas y transiciones suaves. ### 3. REQUISITO FUNDAMENTAL: PLANTILLAS EDITABLES Este punto es indispensable para contratar el servicio. Necesitamos recibir los archivos originales y editables de ambos videos, preferentemente en Canva, CapCut, After Effects, Premiere Pro u otra plataforma que permita modificar fácilmente: - Nombre del niño o niña. - Fecha de la Primera Comunión. - Hora y lugar de la ceremonia. - Nombre de los padres y padrinos. - Fotografías del niño o niña. - Textos y frases religiosas. - Música, cuando corresponda. - Otros detalles personalizados. La edición debe ser sencilla, de modo que nuestro personal pueda modificar los datos de cada cliente y generar un nuevo video sin conocimientos avanzados de edición. **No buscamos solamente dos videos terminados en MP4. Buscamos dos plantillas maestras reutilizables y editables.** ### 4. ENTREGABLES 1. Video final de Primera Comunión para niño en MP4. 2. Video final de Primera Comunión para niña en MP4. 3. Plantilla maestra editable del video para niño. 4. Plantilla maestra editable del video para niña. 5. Archivos originales del proyecto y recursos utilizados. 6. Enlaces de edición o duplicación de las plantillas, si se trabaja con Canva. 7. Breve tutorial de cómo cambiar los datos y fotografías. ### 5. ESPECIFICACIONES - Formato vertical 1080 x 1920 píxeles (9:16), ideal para WhatsApp, Instagram y redes sociales. - Buena resolución y calidad profesional. - Animaciones fluidas. - Tipografías elegantes y legibles. - Música y recursos con licencia que permita su uso comercial. - Sin marcas de agua. ### 6. PERFIL DEL FREELANCER Buscamos una persona que tenga experiencia en: - Diseño de invitaciones digitales animadas. - Edición de videos para eventos. - Motion Graphics. - Canva, After Effects, Premiere Pro o CapCut. - Creación de plantillas editables y reutilizables. **IMPORTANTE:** Al presentar su propuesta, agradeceremos adjuntar trabajos anteriores, indicar qué programa utilizará y confirmar que entregará las plantillas originales editables, con los derechos necesarios para su personalización y uso comercial. opportunities.title: Automatización IA para WooCommerce SEO
opportunities.description: Desarrollo de automatización con IA para actualización masiva de productos WooCommerce (800+ productos) Buscamos un desarrollador especializado en inteligencia artificial y automatizaciones para crear un sistema que permita actualizar automáticamente más de 800 fichas de producto de nuestra tienda online WordPress + WooCommerce. Objetivo Queremos automatizar la incorporación de contenidos SEO proporcionados por nuestra agencia externa. Actualmente recibimos los textos, títulos y metadescripciones en una hoja de cálculo. Necesitamos un sistema que, utilizando IA, sea capaz de interpretar esos contenidos, maquetarlos correctamente y trasladarlos automáticamente a los productos correspondientes. Funcionamiento esperado El sistema recibirá un Excel con las siguientes columnas: * URL del producto. * Nuevo título del producto. * Meta título SEO (si corresponde). * Meta descripción SEO. * Texto SEO completo, incluyendo encabezados H1, H2 y H3. La automatización deberá: 1. Acceder al producto correspondiente mediante su URL. 2. Identificar correctamente el producto en WooCommerce. 3. Actualizar el título y los campos SEO correspondientes. 4. Procesar el texto mediante IA. 5. Generar una maquetación HTML limpia, profesional y visualmente atractiva. 6. Respetar estrictamente los H1, H2 y H3 proporcionados por la agencia. 7. Organizar los textos mediante párrafos, listas, tablas, negritas y bloques cuando corresponda. 8. Mantener los estilos y la estructura visual de nuestra plantilla actual.. Requisitos fundamentales * No modificar precios, SKU, referencias, atributos ni otros datos del producto. * No alterar la plantilla global de Elementor. * No modificar los productos publicados mientras se preparan las nuevas versiones. * Evitar duplicidades de contenido. * Registrar los productos procesados y los errores. * Permitir procesar productos por lotes. * Posibilidad de revisar el resultado antes de publicarlo. Presupuesto Buscamos un presupuesto cerrado para desarrollar el sistema, evitando pagar por cada producto procesado. Nos interesa una solución económica, escalable y que podamos utilizar internamente para futuras actualizaciones de contenido. Importante: Antes de desarrollar el sistema completo, queremos realizar una prueba funcional con 10 productos reales para comprobar la calidad de la maquetación y la correcta actualización de WooCommerce.

📲 Contacto directo en San Agustín, Huila (Colombia): **+57 322 273 9034**.
